row.failure_message:
`simp` failed: maximum number of steps exceeded

Note: The target expression is not type-correct under the `instances` transparency level, which may have triggered the failure. This is usually caused by unfolding of semireducible definitions in prior tactic steps. Use `set_option linter.tacticCheckInstances true` to investigate the source of the issue.
Full error:
  Application type mismatch: The argument
    (fun delivery __veil_state N V => instDecidableOr) x✝¹ (getFrom st0) x✝ x
  has type
    Decidable
      ((getFrom st0).3 x✝ x = true ∨
        ¬(getFrom st0).5 x✝ = true ∧ ∃ sender, x✝¹ sender x✝ = true ∧ (getFrom st0).3 sender x = true)
  but is expected to have type
    Decidable (st0.W x✝ x = true ∨ ¬st0.crashed x✝ = true ∧ ∃ sender, x✝¹ sender x✝ = true ∧ st0.W sender x = true)
  in the application
    @decide (st0.W x✝ x = true ∨ ¬st0.crashed x✝ = true ∧ ∃ sender, x✝¹ sender x✝ = true ∧ st0.W sender x = true)
      ((fun delivery __veil_state N V => instDecidableOr) x✝¹ (getFrom st0) x✝ x)

model.query: assert (¬ (∀ n1 n2 v1 v2, decision n1 v1 ∧ decision n2 v2 → v1 = v2))
model.notes: Tutorial variant overlaps Synchronous/FloodSet but is retained as its own model-bearing file.
